extraction.Name: Charles Lunderman
extraction.NOTES: Patent was sent to him by mail; he signed a receipt for it; did not ask for the patent; was satisfied with the sale; received $6500.00 cash for the land; has six living children — one is married, another helps support himself, and Lunderman works out to support the remaining ones. Notarized before Jas. W. Cross, Notary Public, commission expires 4-28-32, on April 30, 1929. Document number 620.
